emailNotifications.setupTitle: How to install and connect Apprise
emailNotifications.setupAppriseIntro: Apprise is the primary delivery channel. Run an Apprise API gateway and set APPRISE_BASE_URL in the backend .env — the gateway can hold the target URLs itself.
emailNotifications.setupGatewayNote: Recommended images: caronc/apprise or lscr.io/linuxserver/apprise-api. Note: apprise-go is CLI-only with no HTTP server, so it needs a wrapper before Platybill can call it.
emailNotifications.setupMinimalLabel: 1. Start the gateway, then set the minimum (.env)
emailNotifications.setupOptionalLabel: 2. Optional: targets or a saved key (.env)
emailNotifications.setupReachability: The backend container must be able to reach the gateway — use the host IP or a shared Docker network (localhost points at the backend itself). Then use Send test notification above.
emailNotifications.setupSmtpLegacy: Email (SMTP) is an optional legacy fallback used only when Apprise is unset or fails; password reset still requires it.
